digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 and capability routing
propositions: T1 is a blocking criterion that requires web-search grounding but loses access when routed through Bedrock because the provider name does not match the 'anthropic' prefix gate
The web-search decision is currently made by provider-name prefix matching rather than capability registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule for provider qualification
The silent removal of web access from a blocking criterion is unobservable in verdict provenance, making future silent capability withdrawals undetectable
Web access must be guaranteed for T1 on every provider, not optional or provider-dependent, and rebar must supply server-side web search where unavailable rather than gracefully degrade
The capability decision was relocated from anthropic_model.py to capabilities.py taking only a web:bool parameter with no provider/model input, eliminating prefix matching via structural incapability
Provider_provenance.capabilities now records web_access as 'native'|'local'|'off' so any silent withdrawal is observable
